name: Confidence In The Lord
overview: Scripture teaches that true confidence is found in trusting the Lord rather than in human strength or wisdom, as Psalms 118:8 emphasizes the superiority of reliance on God over man. This confidence is rooted in the fear of the Lord, which provides a secure refuge for His children (Proverbs 14:26), and is sustained by God's promise to uphold and strengthen His people (Isaiah 41:10). Believers are assured that the Lord's plans are for their peace and hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11), and that prayer offered in Jesus' name will be answered, reinforcing a deep and personal confidence in God's provision and care (John 16:23).
